title: Isolation and Analysis of Lamina Propria Lymphocytes from Mouse Intestines
author: Kim, Tran, et al.

steps.title: Prepare antibody master mixes
steps.instruction: Create two master mixtures immediately before staining: a surface‑marker panel in HBSS using the dilution factors from Table 1, and an intracellular cytokine/transcription‑factor panel in 1× permeabilization buffer using Table 2. The same fluorophore can be used for CD8a and CD19 as described.

substeps.instruction: Gather all antibodies listed in Table 1 and Table 2.
Dilute each surface‑marker antibody in HBSS to the indicated dilution factor (e.g., CD45 1:400, CD4 1:200, etc.) and combine into a single surface‑marker master mix.

Dilute each intracellular antibody in 1× permeabilization buffer to the indicated dilution factor (e.g., IL‑17A 1:200, IFN‑γ 1:200, FoxP3 1:200, RORγt 1:200) and combine into a single intracellular master mix.
Keep both master mixes on ice until use.

steps.title: Prepare digestion media
steps.instruction: For each sample, pre‑warm 5 mL RPMI‑1640 at 37 °C, add Liberase at the tissue‑specific concentration, and aliquot the digestion buffer into a 50 mL conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑warm RPMI‑1640 medium to 37 °C.
Add Liberase to the pre‑warmed RPMI‑1640 at the concentration recommended for the tissue type.
Aliquot 5 mL of this digestion buffer into a fresh 50 mL conical tube (one tube per sample).

steps.title: Digest intestinal tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue pieces in the digestion buffer at 37 °C, 250 rpm, angled 45°, for 40 min–1 h with vigorous shaking every 15 min; optimal times are 35 min for small intestine, 50 min for large intestine, longer for colitis‑induced colon.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the dissected intestinal tissue into the 5 mL digestion buffer tubes.
Place tubes in a shaker set to 37 °C, 250 rpm, positioned at a 45° angle.
Shake vigorously for 10 s every 15 min during the 40 min–1 h incubation.

steps.title: Filter digested suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the digested tissue through a 100 µm cell strainer into a new 50 mL conical tube, rinsing the original tube with 15 mL ice‑cold HBSS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a fresh 50 mL conical tube fitted with a 100 µm cell strainer on top.
Vortex the digestion tube for 10 s, then pour the suspension through the strainer, discarding undigested fragments.
Add 15 mL ice‑cold HBSS to the original digestion tube, vortex briefly, and pour this rinse through the same strainer.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Spin the filtered cell suspension at 450 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and carefully remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 450 × g, 10 min, 4 °C.
Remove supernatant by vacuum suction or gentle pouring without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare Percoll gradient
steps.instruction: Make 40 % and 80 % Percoll solutions, then layer 4 mL 40 % Percoll with the cell pellet and gently overlay 2.5 mL 80 % Percoll to create a clear interface.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 40 % Percoll (by mixing Percoll with appropriate diluent) and 80 % Percoll solutions.
Aliquot 4 mL 40 % Percoll into a 15 mL conical tube for each sample.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL 40 % Percoll and add to the tube (total 5 mL 40 % Percoll).
Insert a glass Pasteur pipette to the bottom of the tube and slowly add 2.5 mL 80 % Percoll, allowing it to flow beneath the 40 % layer without mixing.
Wait until the 80 % layer is completely added before removing the pipette, preserving the 40/80 % interface.

steps.title: Centrifuge Percoll gradient
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the gradient at 860 × g for 20 min at 21 °C using the lowest acceleration (0 or 1) and no brake (deceleration 0).

substeps.instruction: Set centrifuge to 860 × g, 20 min, 21 °C.
Select acceleration 0 (or 1) and deceleration 0 (no brake).
Load tubes carefully to avoid disturbing the interface.

steps.title: Collect interface lymphocytes
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from the 40/80 % Percoll interface into a fresh tube containing 10 mL HBSS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a new 15 mL conical tube with 10 mL HBSS for each sample.
Remove the upper 40 % Percoll layer until ~4 mL remains.
Using a transfer pipette, collect the cells located at the 40/80 % interface and transfer them to the HBSS tube.

steps.title: Wash lymphocytes
steps.instruction: Wash the collected cells twice with HBSS to remove Percoll.

substeps.instruction: Invert the tube to mix, then centrifuge at 450 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 10 mL HBSS, centrifuge again at 450 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, and discard supernatant.
Optional: perform a second HBSS wash to ensure complete Percoll removal.

steps.title: Pause or proceed to staining
steps.instruction: If needed, resuspend the pellet in 5 mL FACS buffer and keep at 4 °C for up to 12–16 h; otherwise, resuspend in 200 µL HBSS and transfer to a 96‑well round‑bottom plate for immediate staining.

substeps.instruction: For a pause point, add 5 mL FACS buffer, keep on ice (4 °C) up to 16 h.
If no stimulation is required, resuspend in 200 µL HBSS and place cells into a 96‑well round‑bottom plate.

steps.title: Surface marker staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with viability dye, Fc blocker, and surface‑marker antibody mix, washing between each step.

substeps.instruction: Take the 96‑well plate from the incubator.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 2 min at 4 °C; flip plate to discard supernatant.
Wash cells twice with 200 µL HBSS per well (no resuspension), each wash followed by centrifugation at 450 × g for 2 min at 4 °C and flipping to discard supernatant.
Prepare fixable live/dead viability staining solution; if ~15 µL fluid remains in wells, reduce master‑mix volume to 35 µL while keeping reagent amounts constant.
Add 50 µL viability stain per well, resuspend, and incubate 10 min at 4 °C protected from light (foil).
Add 150 µL HBSS, centrifuge 450 × g for 2 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL Fc Blocker per well, resuspend, incubate briefly (optional combined with antibody mix).
Add 150 µL HBSS, centrifuge 450 × g for 2 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL surface‑marker antibody master mix (Table 1) per well, resuspend gently, and incubate 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.
Add 150 µL HBSS, centrifuge 450 × g for 2 min, discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash (add 150 µL HBSS, centrifuge, discard) once more.

steps.title: Intracellular cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Fix/permeabilize cells, then stain with intracellular antibody mix, washing between steps.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization working solution.
Resuspend cells in 150 µL of this solution per well and incubate 20–30 min at 20–22 °C (foil).
Optional pause: after incubation, keep plates at 4 °C for 12–16 h.
Centrifuge at 860 × g for 2 min, discard supernatant by flipping.
Prepare 1× Permeabilization buffer working solution.
Add 200 µL Permeabilization buffer per well, centrifuge 860 × g for 2 min, discard supernatant.
Repeat the Permeabilization wash once more (add 200 µL, centrifuge, discard).
Prepare intracellular antibody master mix (Table 2).
Add 50 µL antibody mix per well, resuspend, and incubate 1 h at 4 °C protected from light.
Add 150 µL 1× Permeabilization buffer, centrifuge 860 × g for 2 min, discard supernatant; repeat this wash twice.
Resuspend final cell pellet in 200 µL FACS buffer.
Optional: add counting beads (Cat. 424902, Biolegend) according to the manufacturer’s protocol for cell‑number determination.
